h1: Custom Black Napkins for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom black napkins in bulk for events, restaurants, or corporate branding. Fast turnaround with Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Black napkins bring a sophisticated, neutral backdrop that makes logos and text pop without competing for attention. Whether you need luncheon or dinner napkins with 1/4 or 1/8 fold, black is a versatile choice for catered lunches, corporate galas, or restaurant supply. Screen printing in one or two colors delivers crisp branding on every napkin.
heroAltText: Stack of custom black napkins with a white logo printed on the corner, ideal for corporate events and catering
